messages:
Ava (Marketing): Heads-up — we need a short customer-facing plan for the degraded inference cluster. Not a full postmortem, but clear status + next steps. Can we map timing and who publishes what?
Sam (Support): +1. Customers already pinging support. Need exact copy for the first 30-min notice.
Diego (SRE): Incident opened by bot, root cause under investigation (redis shard flapping). We'll have a mitigation ETA in ~30–45m.
Jordan (Oncall Bot): INCIDENT 2024-12-05T08:12Z created | Sev 2 | team: eng-sre | channel: #eng-oncall
Priya (Product): For marketing: prioritize concise statuspage + email to paying customers. Social posts only if we have recovery timeline.
Ava (Marketing): Agreed. Drafting a 3-tier message cadence: 1) immediate short banner + email to customers on comms list; 2) 1hr update with root cause/mitigation; 3) final recovery note + follow-up webinar invite if customers ask.
Sam (Support): Routing: please tag customers in Zendesk with incident tag. We'll route high-touch accounts to CSMs. Need the exact subject line for email.
Ava (Marketing): Proposed email subject: "Redwood Inference — Temporary service degradation (Dec 5)". Press-short version for status page banner: "We're experiencing a service degradation impacting inference latency; engineers investigating." Thoughts?
Diego (SRE): That reads fine. Add: "Some requests may time out; retrying is recommended."
Priya (Product): Keep banner neutral and actionable. Add workaround: "If you see increased latency, switch to model variant x-small or enable prefix caching if configured."
Ava (Marketing): Good. Draft statuspage banner copy: `Investigating: increased inference latency affecting a subset of requests. Engineers are working on mitigation. Follow updates here.`
Sam (Support): For email body — short bullets: what happened, who affected, mitigation steps, ETA for next update. I'll paste template in a sec.
Ava (Marketing): Timing plan: T+0 publish statuspage & send email to paid customers (CSM list). T+30m internal sync note + public update. T+60m deeper status + possible rollback/mitigation note. T+4h final recovery + root cause summary. Is that workable?
Diego (SRE): Yes. We should schedule the T+30m update as a quick "we're applying a mitigation" or "investigating deeper" depending on signal.
Priya (Product): Also plan inbound lead routing: we often get spikes in inbound from curious prospects. Marketing — can you set a Slack alert and route leads flagged as 'incident' to SDR queue B for triage?
Ava (Marketing): Yup. I'll ask Ops to tag incoming form submissions with "incident-comm" metadata and auto-assign to SDR-B. Also will add an internal snippet for SDRs: "We're experiencing a transient degradation; share statuspage link and offer 1:1 follow-up if they ask about SLAs."
Sam (Support): Template for paid customer email (paste):

```
Subject: Redwood Inference — Temporary service degradation (Dec 5)
Hi {{contact_first}},
We’re currently investigating increased latency for inference requests that may affect some customers. Our engineers are working on a mitigation. Next update: in 30 minutes.
If you rely on low-latency paths, consider temporarily switching to smaller model variants or enabling prefix caching. We’ll follow up with a recovery note and RCA.
— The Redwood Team
```

Ava (Marketing): Nice and concise. I'll send that with minor localization for EU customers (time zone note).
Priya (Product): For statuspage details, let's use two fields: short_summary (one-line) and expanded_block with mitigation suggestions + affected regions. Example:

```
short_summary: "Investigating increased inference latency affecting a subset of requests."
expanded_block: "Impacted: a subset of customers in us-west and eu-west using on-demand pools. Mitigation: engineers are rebalancing redis shards; users can enable prefix caching or switch to dedicated pools. Follow updates here." 
```

Ava (Marketing): Nice — I'll paste those into the statuspage editor. Also need final copy for support canned response and social standby copy (not sent unless recovery confirmed).
Diego (SRE): ETA for mitigation: rebalancing started, expect partial relief in ~25–35m. Will update.
Sam (Support): For CSMs: quick Slack snippet to paste into customer threads: "We're aware of increased latency; engineers are applying a mitigation. You can follow live updates on the status page: <https://status.redwood.ai> — ping me if the customer is mission-critical and needs an immediate workaround."
Ava (Marketing): I'll create the canned responses and a short internal playbook (1-pager) and pin it in #marketing. Also prepping a short FAQ: "Will my data be affected?" -> "No, only latency; no data loss."
Priya (Product): Good call on FAQ. Also track benchmark messaging — marketing must avoid implying our SLAs were violated unless we confirm. Phrase: "degradation" not "outage" unless Sev1 confirmed.
Ava (Marketing): noted. For webinar planning: if customers ask for postmortem, schedule a 30-min "RCA and Q&A" within 72h. We can reuse our eval bench narrative to show how we avoid regressions.
Diego (SRE): Rebalance completed — seeing partial improvement. Will post metrics snapshot in 10m.
Jordan (Oncall Bot): UPDATE 2024-12-05T08:30Z | Mitigation applied | latency: -30% in sample window | monitoring continues
Sam (Support): Posting the canned email now. CSMs notified. Routing rule created for incoming leads.
Ava (Marketing): Thanks team. I'll post the initial statuspage entry and send the customer email. Will update here with links once published. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Product): After recovery, marketing + product will sync on the customer-facing RCA draft before publishing.
Diego (SRE): Final note: please avoid promising exact recovery times in public; give ranges.
Ava (Marketing): Copy that. Posting now — sharing links in 2 minutes.
Ava (Marketing): P.S. Drafted standby social post (do not publish): "We're investigating increased latency with our inference service; updates on status.redwood.ai." Only publish post-recovery with thank you note.
